mcp.intro: MCP ndi muyezo umene umalola ma AI agent (Claude, Cursor, mapulogalamu anu) kugwira ntchito ndi ntchito zakunja. Agent yokhala ndi token ikhoza kusaka ndi kuwerenga makalata anu ndi zomata (zokhazo zoyang'aniridwa ndi antivirus), kuona olumikizana nawo ndi kalendala, ndi kukonza zolemba. Ikhoza kusintha ndi kutumiza mauthenga pokhapokha mutailola. Zonse zimene agent imachita zimalembedwa.
